capita-mercury-2024: Stable and capable at speed and in everyday riding; a couple noticed a catchy slow-speed twitch.
capita-mercury-2025: Edge hold and stability at speed in a great all-rounder, but several found it sluggish in the park.
capita-the-black-snowboard-of-death-2025: Fast and fun, carving well for freeriding; opinions on the flex differ, some calling it stiff.
jones-mountain-twin-2025: Works on groomers and in powder, though one finds it a bit stiff and heavy for park tricks.
